fact: The AMECC civil registration modernisation project (28 July 2022 to 30 November 2023, funded by France through UNICEF, Ministry of the Interior) carried out a full assessment of the civil registration and vital statistics system in September to November 2022 and worked to interconnect the civil register with other public registers (health, identity, elections, civil service, social security); the source is civil registration only and names no published statistics from it, and says under 10% of marriages and deaths are declared.
title: Evaluation finale du Projet « Appui à la Modernisation de l'Etat civil aux Comores » (AMECC) - Rapport de démarrage, version finale
publisher: UNICEF / Unité de Gestion, Ministère de l'Intérieur (consultants C. Naumann, A. Ouledi)
